Working within multidisciplinary project teams and reporting to a Project Manager, the role is responsible for roadway and municipal engineering design across provincial and municipal jurisdictions, including coordination with transportation, drainage, utility, and servicing disciplines. The position contributes to preliminary and detailed design for major infrastructure projects involving freeways, interchanges, intersections, urban roadways, rural roadways, and associated municipal systems. Responsibilities include design development, technical documentation, quality control, field investigations, and coordination with public-sector stakeholders within regulated transportation environments. The ideal candidate brings 8+ years of civil engineering experience, Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) registration, and demonstrated delivery of Ontario Ministry of Transportation (MTO) and municipal transportation projects. Strong technical expertise in roadway infrastructure, multidisciplinary coordination, and mentorship of junior engineering staff is essential. Key Responsibilities Lead civil roadway design activities for major transportation infrastructure projects involving highways, interchanges, intersections, and municipal roadway networks. Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering inputs related to watermains, sanitary systems, stormwater infrastructure, drainage works, and utility relocations. Support project delivery through preliminary design, detailed design, design review, and technical quality assurance processes. Prepare technical reports, engineering documentation, contract documents, quantity calculations, and cost estimates. Perform quality control reviews of plans, profiles, design models, and engineering quantities developed in Civil 3D, InRoads, and OpenRoads Designer. Conduct field investigations, site inspections, and existing conditions assessments to support engineering design development. Provide technical guidance and design oversight to junior engineers and technical staff. Coordinate stakeholder engagement activities and maintain client relationships with municipal and provincial authorities. Support project schedule development, design coordination, and technical risk management activities. Maintain awareness of current roadway design standards, CAD technologies, and transportation engineering practices. Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering. Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation in Ontario. Minimum 8 years of experience in municipal and transportation infrastructure engineering. Demonstrated experience delivering MTO and municipal transportation projects. Strong knowledge of highway engineering principles, transportation design standards, regulations, policies, and operational procedures. Proven experience supporting preliminary and detailed roadway design assignments. Experience preparing engineering reports, contract documents, engineering drawings, quantity estimates, and construction cost estimates. Proficiency with: AutoCAD Civil 3D MicroStation InRoads OpenRoads Designer Strong stakeholder coordination, communication, problem-solving, and technical reporting skills. Valid driver's license and access to an insured vehicle for field assignments. Assets Experience on freeway reconstruction, interchange improvements, or corridor expansion projects. Experience coordinating municipal servicing infrastructure within roadway projects. Experience working on multidisciplinary infrastructure programs involving utilities and drainage systems. Demonstrated mentoring or technical leadership experience within consulting engineering environments. Exposure to large-scale public infrastructure programs with multiple agency stakeholders. Experience supporting construction-phase engineering services and contract administration activities. Additional Information We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. This role is eligible for a referral bonus in line with the Referral Program. If you have been referred, please provide the name of the employee who has referred you at the time of your application. At Egis, we embrace innovation to tackle challenges and utilize AI in our recruitment process under stringent ethics and compliance policies and in alignment with our values of being a Responsible Company, a People First Company and a Creative Company. Committed to diversity, growth and collaboration, we may leverage AI to support the recruitment process. Egis Canada is an equal opportunities employer offering a competitive salary and benefits to those with the skills suited to the needs of our clients. review_candidates.title: Global Project Management Office Senior Specialist (M/F) - CMA CGM Head Office
review_candidates.description: Job description: YOUR ROLE The Senior PMO is a cornerstone of program governance. Their role is not merely to produce monitoring documentation, but to unite teams around strategic, financial, and timeline objectives. CMA CGM favors an “activist” PMO model: beyond reporting, the Senior PMO is directly involved in certain key aspects of program delivery (risk management, communication, and team capacity building) while leaving initiative owners responsible for execution. The Senior PMO must constantly question the value of meetings, templates, and deliverables, systematically asking: “How does this advance the program’s objectives?” WHAT ARE YOU GOING TO DO ? Cross-Functional Coordination and Steering Maintain a cross-functional view of the program to identify material impacts between initiatives and anticipate interdependencies. Organize decision-making: bring together the right stakeholders to address bottlenecks. Consolidate work plans, objectives, and progress across all program initiatives. Performance and Risk Management Implement and maintain a simple and effective monitoring and reporting system (milestones, metrics). Proactively identify risks and areas of concern at the program level to enable rapid resolution. Prepare decision-making materials and coordinate the preparation of steering committee (SteerCo) meetings. Prioritization and Allocation of Effort Apply a prioritization matrix (importance/urgency vs. complexity) to determine the level of involvement required for each initiative. Distinguish between high-stakes strategic decisions (to be handled directly) and reactive or administrative tasks (to be delegated to the PMO team). Adjust your support approach based on the maturity and dynamics of each project team (autonomy, enhanced support, close oversight, and applying pressure when necessary). Communication and Stakeholder Relations Communicate regularly and proactively with executives and key stakeholders regarding the program’s progress and risks. Manage the flow of information between the program, support functions, and the steering committee. Contribute to the approval of strategic messages disseminated throughout the organization, without usurping the sponsors’ responsibility. Capacity Building and Team Facilitation Support project managers in developing their skills (methodology, tools, best practices). Liaise with experts from other departments to address identified skill gaps. Contribute to recruitment, workload management, and the continuity of the PMO team. Decision-Making Excellence Promote high-quality decision-making: clear processes, defined responsibilities, and stakeholder buy-in. Adapt the decision-making approach to the nature of the issue: thorough consideration for structural decisions that are difficult to reverse, and delegation and speed for reversible decisions. Encourage constructive debate and the “disagree and commit” principle to avoid deadlocks. Profile description: WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR ? Engineering degree, business school degree, or equivalent; training in project/program management is a plus (PMP, Prince2, or equivalent). At least 8 to 10 years of experience in managing complex programs and/or in consulting, ideally with experience in a transformation PMO environment. Experience in the maritime, logistics, or transportation sector is a plus but not required. Cross-functional leadership and the ability to bring together teams without a direct reporting relationship. Excellent communication and analytical skills, with the ability to present confidently to an executive committee. Methodological rigor in program management (planning, reporting, risk management, and dependency management). Ability to prioritize and balance focus on strategic issues with the delegation of operational tasks. Comfortable in an ambiguous, demanding, and ever-changing environment; ability to move issues forward even with incomplete information. Proficiency in project management and reporting tools (Office/Google Suite, PPM tools, dashboards). Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken (international environment).

This is a senior leadership role with a clear strategic ambition to grow beyond $1bn revenue by 2030. The GM will lead 1500 people through ten direct reports and shape strategy across EMEA and globally, including operations in the United States and China. The role will combine direct leadership of Product Line Management, Marketing, Engineering and Operations with influence across the sales organisation, supply chain and quality. It carries full accountability for business performance and portfolio direction. What You’ll Do Translate strategy into profitable growth Lead overall LSDPI strategy and execution, delivering profitable growth and market expansion across EMEA and global product lines. Build and execute long-term business plans aligned with divisional and regional priorities, with full P&L responsibility and delivery of financial targets. Lead transformation and growth initiatives that strengthen competitive positioning and accelerate business performance. Shape portfolio and market choices Define product strategy, roadmaps and lifecycle plans, making clear choices on where Eaton should invest, accelerate, modernise, localise, expand, contain or stop. Keep strategy connected to execution Provide strategic leadership to Engineering to support innovation, product development and customer requirements. Align Engineering with market needs, technology trends, regulatory requirements and product-roadmap priorities, fostering innovation and accelerating speed-to-market. Partner with Sales, Supply Chain and Quality to align commercial, engineering and operational priorities and support world-class operational performance and customer outcomes. Build the organisation and lead transformation Build and lead a high-performing, internationally distributed leadership team and organisation, with clear accountability for business, portfolio and functional outcomes. Develop talent, succession, organisational capability and leadership effectiveness across the division. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and customer focus. Success will be reflected in profitable growth, stronger market positions, faster innovation, successful portfolio modernisation, increased recurring revenue, stronger organisational capability and disciplined execution through the matrix. What You'll Bring Broad general management experience with direct P&L accountability in a sizeable, complex and international business. Experience working across multiple product lines, countries or market channels in a large global organisation. Experience translating enterprise and regional priorities into end-to-end business, product-line and commercial strategy. Strong commercial and product-line orientation, with evidence of converting strategy into accelerated profitable growth. Experience leading product management, marketing, engineering and operations, and aligning sales, supply chain and quality through a matrix. Track record of portfolio transformation, new product introduction, digitalisation and innovation in highly regulated markets. Success influencing senior commercial, engineering, operational and functional leaders to align priorities and investment choices. Experience building and leading cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Preferred Direct experience in electrical, power management, lighting, fire, life safety, building technology or another regulated engineered-product environment. Qualifications Significant general management and leadership experience, including direct P&L responsibility at $XXXm scale. Experience leading managers and geographically distributed cross-functional teams. How You'll Lead Eaton’s Culture Model calls on leaders to Win Together, Think Big and Act Boldly. Identify where connected products, digital services, stronger channels and Eaton’s broader commercial reach can create meaningful customer and enterprise value. Balance long-term portfolio direction with near-term performance and customer commitments. Act Boldly - Make explicit choices rather than producing broad strategic themes. Challenge incremental thinking, outdated technology, weak market coverage and unsupported investment logic.
